description: Cover Aadhaar, PAN, phone numbers, email addresses, account numbers and other identifiers in a PDF or picture, returning the redacted file.

file.description: The file, base64-encoded (a data: URL also works). Up to 5 MB.

lang.description: OCR languages joined by +, such as eng+hin. Default eng.

ocr.description: PDF: auto (default) uses OCR only when the PDF has no text.

types.description: Kinds to cover, comma-separated, as in /v1/text/redact (aadhaar, pan, phone, email ...). Default all.

name: redact_document
title: Redact document
